svg.aria-label: A universe in every layer. A moon rises through its phases from behind a planet's limb while seven concentric rings light from the centre outward. At full moon nine seals lock onto the rings and dawn light breaks across the sky. The rings are seven layers of work across sixteen repositories: learning core, data, models, applied AI, agents, knowledge and quantum.
svg.text: 7 LAYERS · 16 REPOSITORIES · ALL MINE, NO FORKS · BUILT OUTWARD FROM THE CORE
Foundations at the centre. Frontiers at the edge.
